summary: Traveller's Tales' Lego Harry Potter games adapt the film/book years into co-op Lego action-adventure structure, now bundled in the remastered Lego Harry Potter Collection.

entries.title: Lego Harry Potter: Years 1-4
entries.definitive_edition: LEGO Harry Potter Collection for current complete route; original 2010 release for strict history

emulation.notes: Native PC/current console route is preferred; handheld emulation only for platform comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current remastered Collection with route/state documented

primary.why: The 2024 LEGO Harry Potter Collection is the current official route on PC and current consoles, bundling Years 1-4 and Years 5-7 with remastered graphics and DLC packs. The original 2010 PC/console release remains the strict historical route, while handheld versions differ.
primary.how_to_play: Use LEGO Harry Potter Collection on PC/current console for current access, or the original 2010 PC version for exact launch behavior. Record collection/original route, build, co-op state, story year/level, collectibles, character/spell unlocks, DLC pack state, graphics settings, and whether handheld versions were compared.

secondary.why: The current Collection remasters the game and bundles additional material.
They are not equivalent to the main PC/console route.

all_releases.platform: Windows PC / PlayStation 3 / Xbox 360 / Wii / PlayStation 2

all_releases.fidelity: Current remastered compilation with Years 1-4, Years 5-7, and DLC packs.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The current Collection is remastered and bundled; original 2010 and handheld routes should be labeled separately.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record remaster/original route, DLC state, and co-op/collectible progress.
